topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Oh my gosh, can you even believe it? We found a time capsule, and we didn't even plant it! It's like a mystery wrapped in a box, and we get to be the detectives. I mean, who else could have left it here? And how long has it been waiting for us? It’s almost like it was meant to be found now, right? We have to figure out what’s inside, who put it there, and why. It’s such an amazing adventure, I can’t wait to see what treasures we uncover! Let’s get this party started, shall we?
